claims: Ni-8.8 at.% Zr (literature, Okamoto et al.)
Ni-9.0 at.% Zr (literature, Wang et al.; Bochvar et al.)
Ni-10.0 at.% Zr (this work, experimental determination)

evidence.quote: Okamoto et al. [16] reported that the eutectic reaction takes place at 1443 K, where liquid Ni-8.8 at.% Zr alloy solidifies to fcc (Ni) and compound Ni5Zr cooperatively.
the eutectic point was determined as Ni-10.0 at.% Zr alloy with a transition temperature of 1467 K, and the relevant part of Ni–Zr phase diagram was revised accordingly.
